preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 5000 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within bounds: 1 ≤ n ≤ 5000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 5000, 1 ≤ s ≤ n, and 1 ≤ u_i, v_i ≤ n for each road.
Input has exactly m + 1 lines: first line with n, m, s; followed by m lines of roads.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself (u_i ≠ v_i).
Each road line contains exactly two integers (u_i, v_i).

postconditions.description: Output is a non-negative integer ≤ n - 1, representing the minimum number of new roads needed to make all cities reachable from s.

postconditions.expression: let cities = set(range(1, int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) + 1)); let s = int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[2]); let roads = {tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]}; let reachable = set(); let stack = [s]; while stack: node = stack.pop(); if node not in reachable: reachable.add(node); stack.extend([v for u, v in roads if u == node]); let answer = int(stdout.strip()); answer == len(cities) - len(reachable) if len(reachable) < len(cities) else 0
postconditions.description: If the number of cities reachable from s (via existing roads) is less than n, the output equals the number of cities not reachable from s (i.e., n - |reachable|). Otherwise, the output is 0.
